description: Get the member profile of the currently authenticated Trello user (the 'me' member).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the current member object (id, username, full_name, email, initials); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the open boards the currently authenticated member belongs to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of board objects (id, name, desc, closed, idOrganization, url, idMembers); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single board by its id.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the board object; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the open lists belonging to a board, sorted by position.

board_id.description: The unique id of the board.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of list objects (id, name, idBoard, pos, closed); on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the open cards belonging to a list, sorted by position.

list_id.description: The unique id of the list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of card objects; on failure (list not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single card by its id.

card_id.description: The unique id of the card.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the card object; on failure (card not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new card in a list. The card is positioned after existing cards in the list.

id_list.description: The id of the list the card is created in.

desc.description: Optional description text for the card.

due.description: Optional due date/time in ISO 8601 format.

member_ids.description: Optional list of member ids to assign to the card.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created card object; on failure (list not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing card by its id.

card_id.description: The unique id of the card to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the card.

desc.description: Optional new description for the card.

id_list.description: Optional new list id to move the card to (also updates the card's board).

due.description: Optional new due date/time; pass an empty string to clear it.

closed.description: Optional new closed (archived) state for the card.

pos.description: Optional new position of the card within its list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated card object; on failure (card or target list not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a card by its id, also removing any checklists attached to it.

card_id.description: The unique id of the card to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion (_value, deleted, id); on failure (card not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the checklists attached to a card.

card_id.description: The unique id of the card.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of checklist objects (id, name, idCard, idBoard, checkItems); on failure (card not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new (empty) checklist on a card.

id_card.description: The id of the card the checklist is created on.

name.description: The name of the checklist (defaults to 'Checklist').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created checklist object; on failure (card not found), output contains an error message.
